title: Editing or deleting an unused term sends nothing to QuickBooks
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop is connected to QuickBooks and edits, then deletes, a term of its own that nobody uses.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The test organization is connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company, and you can sign in to that company in another tab.
  • The shop's own term {Term-B}, due 14 days after the invoice date, is held by nobody and is not in QuickBooks.
    For example: {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S8-07b Unused.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-B} row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. Replace 14 with 21 in the Days box.
  4. Click "Save Changes".
  5. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-B} row.
  6. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  7. Click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
  8. In QuickBooks, open the Terms list (Settings, All lists, Terms).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the window opens.
  • Step 3: the blue information line shows below the options.
  • Step 4: a green success toast shows.
  • Step 5: the menu opens.
  • Step 6: the confirmation opens.
  • Step 7: the toast "{Term-B} deleted" shows.
  • Step 8: {Term-B} never appeared.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11677 (Story 8, QuickBooks sync - credit terms)

  • S8-R7: “Deactivating, reactivating, editing or deleting a term in ShopView sends nothing to QuickBooks. A term already created in QuickBooks stays there.”
  • S8-N2: “A term the shop created but nobody has used on a synced record is never sent to QuickBooks.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
